scope: Freezes a publication-quality evaluation protocol comparing native SPA2M (CONTROL, frozen), SPA2M+ParT (TEST, not yet trained), and native SPA10M (secondary scale reference, frozen), written before any ParT2M result exists. Predeclares primary metrics (exact-event HH reconstruction efficiency, Higgs assignment/pairing accuracy as a genuinely distinct metric, all-background/QCD/ttbar AUC, background rejection at epsS in {10,7.5,5,4,3}%), secondary robustness metrics (mass resolution, score-mass correlation, jet-multiplicity/topology strata, raw tight-tail survivor counts, runtime/GPU memory/parameter count), reuses this project's existing paired-bootstrap/McNemar/Poisson-interval implementation and adds one new statistic (exact binomial interval), freezes a mechanical GO/NO-GO rule for more ParT2M seeds and additional8M authorization, and defines Story A/B/C outcomes falsifiably. Produces JSON schemas, a table generator, and a figure generator, all exercised end-to-end against synthetic (not real) fixture data.

audit_2026_09_10.trigger: Pre-result audit of the frozen protocol, requested before SPA2M+ParT (TEST) had been trained or scored -- no ParT2M result had been seen.
audit_2026_09_10.finding: The 2026-09-09 higgs1_assignment_correct/higgs2_assignment_correct schema silently assumed a canonical, symmetry-safe H1-vs-H2 labeling that does not exist. The two Higgs bosons in HH->4b are an explicit PERMUTATIONS.EVENT: [h1,h2] symmetry in this project's own SPA-Net event topology (event_config/trackb_hh4b.yaml), confirmed authoritative by the official SPANet library's own validation_average_jet_accuracy code (spanet/network/jet_reconstruction/jet_reconstruction_validation.py), which takes the argmax over ALL event-level truth permutations before scoring -- the same principle this fix applies.
audit_2026_09_10.provenance_correction: The original PREREGISTRATION.md claim that the new per-Higgs metric was 'equivalent to this project's established per_higgs_pairing_accuracy convention (pn_c7x_spanet_evaluation.py)' was FALSE and is withdrawn: pn_c7x_spanet_evaluation.py's learned_per_higgs_pairing_accuracy/learned_per_jet_partner_accuracy are literal aliases of learned_exact_event_pairing_accuracy (same variable, learned_accuracy), computed on an unrelated single discrete partition-label representation -- it never established a genuinely distinct partial-credit metric. The correct, already-existing, symmetry-safe precedent is paper_exports/track_b_harvey_tail_characterization_20260825_v1/work/part6_pairing_accuracy_and_mass.py (2026-08-25), whose {frozenset(...)} set-matching and n_pairs_correct/2.0 formula this fix's pred_b1..pred_b4/truth_b1..truth_b4 field-naming and match_higgs_pairs() logic are deliberately aligned with.
audit_2026_09_10.bonus_bug_found_and_fixed: While rewriting the reconstruction-metrics code path, found that paired_bootstrap_delta_exact_event_efficiency's stat_fn ignored its own `scores` argument and always read a `correct_arr` kwarg fixed to TEST's array regardless of whether the control or test statistic was being evaluated -- so the reported delta was always exactly 0 (test_mean - test_mean) with a degenerate zero-width CI, silently non-functional rather than visibly absent. Fixed in the same rewrite; verified non-degenerate on synthetic data (observed_delta=0.232, CI (0.205,0.256), std=0.013).
audit_2026_09_10.secondary_audit_bootstrap_threshold: Verified empirically (new test_bootstrap_threshold_recompute.py, 3/3 passing) that the signal-efficiency threshold for background-rejection-at-fixed-epsS IS recomputed inside every bootstrap replicate (resampled scores/labels/process arrays are what the threshold is derived from on every call) -- NO BUG FOUND, no amendment needed for this item, recorded as audited-and-confirmed rather than silently assumed correct.
audit_2026_09_10.secondary_audit_exporter_readiness: part2_spanet_assignment.py already proves predicted-index extraction is working, low-risk code against the real frozen CONTROL checkpoint today. No concrete unified exporter (predicted + truth indices + score + process + masses + n_jets, schema-conformant) currently exists for either arm. Recommendation (not performed by this audit): write and dry-run such an exporter against CONTROL now, before TEST exists, so schema-conformance is proven before results, not after.
audit_2026_09_10.note: This audit corrects a genuine correctness/implementation bug and a provenance citation; it does not touch, and was not motivated by, the decision rule's conservatism.
